cursor.subject: Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-0.6B matched German/noise comparator
cursor.prior_exception: Dataset scripts are no longer supported, but found fleurs.py

observations: At the exact pinned FLEURS revision bc0636b, Hugging Face marks the commit as adding de_de config data files and the revision still contains fleurs.py.
At that same pinned revision, de_de/test-00000-of-00001.parquet exists as a concrete 726 MB dataset artifact, alongside train and validation Parquet files.
Hugging Face Datasets v3.6.0 documentation states that dataset loading scripts may be executed when trust_remote_code=True; Parquet datasets do not intrinsically require a script.

The existing F2 repair patch makes exactly two bounded changes: adds trust_remote_code=True to load_dataset and pins datasets==3.6.0. This directly targets the observed script-loader incompatibility without changing the semantic comparator, FLEURS revision, German rows, ASR models, gate contract, scoring, or baseline.

counterhypotheses_and_fences: datasets==3.6.0 plus trust_remote_code may still fail because of a dependency/runtime interaction unrelated to the dataset-script policy; only a rerun can discriminate this.
A future Parquet-native loader can reduce remote-code and legacy-loader surface, but introducing it before the first repaired rerun would enlarge the semantic change and risk runtime-subject churn.
Do not interpret presence of pinned Parquet files as proof that the current comparator has executed successfully or that row/audio identities match until the receipt records actual hashes and rows.

convergence_decision.next_exact_action: Trigger4 should materialize the already-bound two-line datasets36/trust_remote_code repair into the canonical ASR004 comparator subject and execute exactly one matched rerun on clay-direct-dev. Trigger7 should consume and classify that receipt before any ASR model or comparator mutation. If this exact repair still fails at loader/dependency level, then evaluate a Parquet-native loader as a second bounded repair while preserving the same pinned FLEURS revision and row/audio identity checks.
